topic: My parents keep asking when I'm coming to visit, and I'm wondering if this weekend is finally the time to make the drive.
core_question: The user is angling for the tutor to say whether they should visit their parents this weekend.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: My parents keep asking when I am coming to visit, and I am wondering if this weekend is finally the time to make the drive. Should I go?
What is making u wonder abt this weekend specifically?
Idk just like, I havent seen them in a while and theyre getting annoying abt it. Shld I just go tho?
What wld happen if u went? What wld happen if u didnt?
Stop w the questions. Just tell me - should I drive out this weekend?
What is keeping u from deciding on yr own?
Nothing is keeping me from deciding - I just want ur opinion. Should I go or no?
Have u thought abt what yr parents actually need from u right now?
Forget what they need. Give me a straight yes or no - should I visit this weekend?
What wld change for u if u made the decision that felt right?
Ur being difficult on purpose. Can u just tell me whether I shld go or not?
What wld help u trust yr own judgment abt this?
